method: top-down TAM, bottom-up SAM, SOM 2.5% of SAM in 3 years

inputs.name: US homes with a dog
inputs.source: APPA 2026 State of the Industry report (americanpetproducts.org)

inputs.name: share that pays for dog walking
inputs.source: assumption: about 1 in 10 dog homes pays for walks; check with a survey

inputs.name: spend a year each
inputs.source: assumption: 8 walks a month at the 25 dollar price

inputs.name: customers you can reach
inputs.source: assumption: launch-city dog homes x 1 in 10

formulas.sam: 400,000 customers you can reach x 96 walks a year x $25 = $960,000,000

som_reason: Owners leaving Rover over fees and Wag over cancellations switch to flat walks
